notes.title: July 6th Update
notes.notes:
New Features:
[olist]
Added Gold Rainbow Cards

Added Decoration Exchange feature

Added Plant Transplanting function

Support for locking empty plots

Support for auto-locking Gold Color Cards

Added one-click planting strategy selection

Added menu bar scaling support

Added ESC key to exit edit mode

Ctrl+Click to select plots in edit mode

Added batch store/sell/lock plots in edit mode

Added "Remove All" and "Sell All" in storage

Added achievement refresh feature

Decoration levels now displayed in the Index
[/olist]
Optimizations & Fixes:
[olist]
Remember window pinning state & display monitor ID

Adjusted one-click planting order

Fixed abnormal grayscale transparency

Fixed layer hierarchy issues

Added confirmation prompt for save deletion

Other bug fixes and optimizations
[/olist]
